meta.title: All In – 1
meta.description: I am a Doll that makes the impossible possible.

units.rawText: Millennium Pegasus, prepare for launch... All agents, prepare to withdraw now! Xinghuan and I will catch up with you!
units.displayText: Millennium Pegasus, prepare for launch... All agents, prepare to withdraw now! Xinghuan and I will catch up with you!

spans.text: Millennium Pegasus, prepare for launch... All agents, prepare to withdraw now! Xinghuan and I will catch up with you!

units.rawText: Xinghuan, how's the download progress now?
units.displayText: Xinghuan, how's the download progress now?

spans.text: Xinghuan, how's the download progress now?

units.rawText: We're at 80%!
units.displayText: We're at 80%!

spans.text: We're at 80%!

units.rawText: Don't worry about intercepting the entropics, I'll handle it. Just protect the backups!
units.displayText: Don't worry about intercepting the entropics, I'll handle it. Just protect the backups!

spans.text: Don't worry about intercepting the entropics, I'll handle it. Just protect the backups!

units.rawText: Yuwang switches rapidly between multiple command consoles while simultaneously monitoring the sensor feeds from the entire base.
units.displayText: Yuwang switches rapidly between multiple command consoles while simultaneously monitoring the sensor feeds from the entire base.

spans.text: Yuwang switches rapidly between multiple command consoles while simultaneously monitoring the sensor feeds from the entire base.

units.rawText: If I can just hold the entropics here... We'll have a chance.
units.displayText: If I can just hold the entropics here... We'll have a chance.

spans.text: If I can just hold the entropics here... We'll have a chance.

units.rawText: Hsss—
units.displayText: Hsss—

spans.text: Hsss—

units.rawText: The purple tide of entropics pours into the range of the point defense guns. Despite their unending stream of suppressive fire, there are still some entropics that manage to break through the blockade and attempt to maul the operand barrier.
units.displayText: The purple tide of entropics pours into the range of the point defense guns. Despite their unending stream of suppressive fire, there are still some entropics that manage to break through the blockade and attempt to maul the operand barrier.

spans.text: The purple tide of entropics pours into the range of the point defense guns. Despite their unending stream of suppressive fire, there are still some entropics that manage to break through the blockade and attempt to maul the operand barrier.

units.rawText: Dammit... these entropics are just like locusts...
units.displayText: Dammit... these entropics are just like locusts...

spans.text: Dammit... these entropics are just like locusts...

units.rawText: Yuwang can feel his fingertips going numb. Ever since he took over control of the defense systems, his body has been approaching its limits.
units.displayText: Yuwang can feel his fingertips going numb. Ever since he took over control of the defense systems, his body has been approaching its limits.

spans.text: Yuwang can feel his fingertips going numb. Ever since he took over control of the defense systems, his body has been approaching its limits.

units.rawText: I guess... trying to handle an entire base's processes with a single person's operands is just too difficult, huh?
units.displayText: I guess... trying to handle an entire base's processes with a single person's operands is just too difficult, huh?

spans.text: I guess... trying to handle an entire base's processes with a single person's operands is just too difficult, huh?

units.rawText: On the outskirts of Titan Base.
units.displayText: On the outskirts of Titan Base.

spans.text: On the outskirts of Titan Base.

units.rawText: Clouds and smoke fill the sky, drowning out the sunlight. The dark meteors are like demon's claws, ripping through the cloud cover and gouging deeply into the land. The aura of destruction that suffuses them tears at the boundary between land and sky as they throw up rocks in a leaping, mad dance.
units.displayText: Clouds and smoke fill the sky, drowning out the sunlight. The dark meteors are like demon's claws, ripping through the cloud cover and gouging deeply into the land. The aura of destruction that suffuses them tears at the boundary between land and sky as they throw up rocks in a leaping, mad dance.

spans.text: Clouds and smoke fill the sky, drowning out the sunlight. The dark meteors are like demon's claws, ripping through the cloud cover and gouging deeply into the land. The aura of destruction that suffuses them tears at the boundary between land and sky as they throw up rocks in a leaping, mad dance.

units.rawText: The thunderous roar of their impact rattles the eardrums as gravel sprays everywhere, and the humanoid entropic watching all this smiles in satisfaction.
units.displayText: The thunderous roar of their impact rattles the eardrums as gravel sprays everywhere, and the humanoid entropic watching all this smiles in satisfaction.

spans.text: The thunderous roar of their impact rattles the eardrums as gravel sprays everywhere, and the humanoid entropic watching all this smiles in satisfaction.

units.rawText: <color=DA70D6>Yes, destroy everything, until Titan, largest of Saturn's moons, wails in despair from within my grasp!</color>
units.displayText: Yes, destroy everything, until Titan, largest of Saturn's moons, wails in despair from within my grasp!

spans.text: Yes, destroy everything, until Titan, largest of Saturn's moons, wails in despair from within my grasp!

units.rawText: Hsss—
units.displayText: Hsss—

spans.text: Hsss—

units.rawText: <color=DA70D6>Those pathetic ant-like agents are still putting up their pointless resistance with that puny pathetic barrier of theirs.</color>
units.displayText: Those pathetic ant-like agents are still putting up their pointless resistance with that puny pathetic barrier of theirs.

spans.text: Those pathetic ant-like agents are still putting up their pointless resistance with that puny pathetic barrier of theirs.

units.rawText: <size=40><color=DA70D6>AHAHAHAHAHAHA!!! BEG FOR MERCY! NOT THAT IT WILL SAVE YOU AHAHAHAHAHA!!!!!</color></size>
units.displayText: AHAHAHAHAHAHA!!! BEG FOR MERCY! NOT THAT IT WILL SAVE YOU AHAHAHAHAHA!!!!!

spans.text: AHAHAHAHAHAHA!!! BEG FOR MERCY! NOT THAT IT WILL SAVE YOU AHAHAHAHAHA!!!!!

units.rawText: All the meteors instantly gather to one location and rain down toward the base in a pinpoint bombardment!
units.displayText: All the meteors instantly gather to one location and rain down toward the base in a pinpoint bombardment!

spans.text: All the meteors instantly gather to one location and rain down toward the base in a pinpoint bombardment!

units.rawText: The land shakes, dirt flies, and the impact of the meteors sparks a huge blaze which consumes everything.
units.displayText: The land shakes, dirt flies, and the impact of the meteors sparks a huge blaze which consumes everything.
